easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Vizier of Many Faces
description:
Activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Rakdos Joins Up to become a creature.
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Vizier of Many Faces's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Vizier of Many Faces's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent and causing you to gain that much life.
Resolve Vizier of Many Faces's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 3.
